metadata.description: Agent Memory Toolkit plugins for GitHub Copilot.

plugins.name: amt-memory
plugins.description: Persistent, scoped agent memory (personal, team, org) backed by Azure Cosmos DB, delivered through the Inference Platform gateway. Bundles the AMT MCP server, a memory skill, deterministic inject/capture hooks, a Memory canvas, and one-click import of GitHub Copilot memory and sessions.
